profile.name: Michel Atucha
profile.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer · Java · Flutter · React

summary: Senior Full-Stack Developer with 11+ years building scalable enterprise applications and SaaS platforms. Founded and scaled TuFacturero, a nationwide electronic invoicing platform serving thousands of daily active users across Ecuador. Currently leading EcuaFirma development at Touwolf, delivering mission-critical digital signature solutions for financial institutions and government entities. Expert in Java/Spring Boot backends, Flutter mobile apps, and React frontends. Seeking remote opportunities worldwide to leverage expertise in fintech, e-government, and high-scale distributed systems.
